faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Civil Court Katihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Civil Court Katihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Civil Court Katihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Katihar, by in person or registered post, to reach by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not printed; remuneration governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna; post-wise experience and skill requirements apply. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the last three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Those subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual; can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.
